maintenance_led.reason: Most revenue comes from selling new storage systems, software and cloud services, plus support contracts; not mainly repair of existing installations.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private enterprises such as banks, chip designers, healthcare providers and media; public sector is a minor segment.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own storage, cloud and AI data products, with only occasional small acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Enterprise storage and data infrastructure holds core data; migrating petabytes and changing platforms risks downtime and disruption.
